name: Sulaimanisuchus
isnote: PBDB places it in the Sulaimanisuchidae, which has no clade entry in the atlas yet; placed in Neosuchia.
sum: Sulaimanisuchus is a crocodyliform named in 2010 from the Maastrichtian Vitakri Formation of Pakistan.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: Catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
material: One occurrence in the Vitakri Formation.
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
author: Malkani 2010
